title: Used Car Inspection Authorization Form
subtitle: Used Vehicle Inspection: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Used Car Inspection Authorization Form turns vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input into a customer-facing Used Vehicle Inspection consent record. The vehicle inspection coordinator itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the customer / vehicle owner's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Used Car Inspection Authorization Form at inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area. Verify applicable Used Vehicle Inspection requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the customer / vehicle owner's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input scope or cost changes.
